headline: Securden Recognized in the 2026 Gartner® Research: Reduce Cybersecurity Attacks With Least Privilege Endpoint Strategies
summary: Securden, Inc., a leading provider of Privileged Access and Identity Security solutions, today announced that it has been recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® research: Reduce Cybersecurity Attacks With Least Privilege Endpoint Strategies, by Paul Mezzera and Michael Kelley (July 2026). The research identifies Securden as a Representative Vendor for Privileged Access Management (PAM), which offers Privilege Elevation and Delegation Management (PEDM) as a core feature.
